Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)

rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may return a spell from your mana zone to your hand.

rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Return a spell from your mana zone to your hand.

rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)

rulesText: While all the cards in your mana zone are light cards, this creature has "Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)"

name: Sundrop Armor
rulesText: Add a card from your hand to your shields face down.
flavorText: "The danger hasn't passed. But we have." —Miar, Comet Elemental

name: Ur Pale, Seeker of Sunlight
rulesText: While all the cards in your mana zone are light cards, this creature gets +2000 power.

rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
While all the cards in your mana zone are water cards, this creature gets +3000 power.

name: Aqua Deformer
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, return 2 cards from your mana zone to your hand. Then your opponent chooses 2 cards in his mana zone and returns them to his hand.
flavorText: Nothing is quite what it seems.

name: Emeral
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may add a card from your hand to your shields face down. If you do, choose one of your shields and put it into your hand. You can't use the "shield trigger" ability of that shield.
flavorText: "If you think I'm good at this, watch me play video games!"

name: Flood Valve
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Return a card from your mana zone to your hand.
flavorText: "Open up freshwater valve 23D. I'm thirsty."

flavorText: A swarm of fish surround it, hoping to feed on its leftovers.

name: King Ponitas
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, search your deck. You may take a water card from your deck, show that card to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: "I caught five fishermen today. But you should have seen the one that got away!"

name: Legendary Bynor
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Leviathans.
Your other water creatures in the battle zone can't be blocked.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "I can see my ocean from here."

name: Liquid Scope
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Look at your opponent's hand and shields. Then put the shields back where they were.
flavorText: "Let's find out if your brain is ticklish." —Legendary Bynor

name: Psychic Shaper
rulesText: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put all water cards from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
flavorText: Think. Think harder. No, not that hard.

name: Shtra
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, return a card from your mana zone to your hand. Then your opponent chooses a card in his mana zone and returns it to his hand.
flavorText: Living underwater means never having to take a bath.

name: Stinger Ball
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may look at one of your opponent's shields. Then put it back where it was.

name: Baraga, Blade of Gloom
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, choose one of your shields and put it into your hand. You can't use the "shield trigger" ability of that shield.

rulesText: When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battle zone, you may return a creature from your mana zone to your hand.

rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)

rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may return a darkness creature from your graveyard to your hand.

rulesText: Choose any number of your shields and put them into your hand. You can't use the "shield trigger" abilities of those shields.
flavorText: If you're not getting nightmares, you're not trying hard enough.

flavorText: From the rotting trees of the Fiana Woods, a new horror oozes forth.

name: Jack Viper, Shadow of Doom
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Ghosts.
Whenever another of your darkness creatures would be put into your graveyard from the battle zone, you may return it to your hand instead.
flavorText: Has it conquered death, or has it just replaced it with something worse?

name: Mudman
rulesText: While all the cards in your mana zone are darkness cards, this creature gets +2000 power.
flavorText: "We all crawl from the slime. Someday, we'll all return to it."

name: Scratchclaw
rulesText:
Slayer (When this creature loses a battle, destroy the other creature.)
This creature gets +1000 power for each other darkness creature you have in the battle zone.
flavorText: "Uh oh. My nose itches!"

name: Snake Attack
rulesText:
Each of your creatures in the battle zone gets "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "double breaker" breaks 2 shields.)
Choose one of your shields and put it into your graveyard.

name: Wailing Shadow Belbetphlo
rulesText: Slayer (When this creature loses a battle, destroy the other creature.)
flavorText: The faster it runs from its pain, the faster its pain catches others.

rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, put a non-fire card from your mana zone into your graveyard. Then your opponent chooses a non-fire card in his mana zone and puts it into his graveyard.

name: Baby Zoppe
rulesText: While all the cards in your mana zone are fire cards, this creature gets +2000 power.
flavorText: Some Fire Birds are so eager to get into battle they don't bother to finish hatching first.

name: Blaze Cannon
rulesText:
You can cast this spell only if all the cards in your mana zone are fire cards.
Each of your creatures in the battle zone gets "power attacker +4000" and "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "power attacker +4000" and "double breaker" gets +4000 power while attacking and breaks 2 shields.)

name: Boltail Dragon
rulesText: Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "Leviathans? I can juggle Leviathans!"

name: Explosive Dude Joe
flavorText: "I used to have a real problem with exploding. But now, thanks to a balanced diet and regular exercise, I've cut my explosion rate to twice a day. I can't take all the credit, though. The support of my wonderful family has finally let me lead a normal"-BOOM!

name: Flametropus
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a card from your mana zone into your graveyard. rulesText:
Destroy all your opponent's creatures that have power 3000 or less.

name: Snip Striker Bullraizer
rulesText: This creature can't attack while your opponent has more creatures in the battle zone than you do.
flavorText: "You're getting more than just a haircut."

rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Armored Dragons. Each of your other fire creatures in the battle zone has "power attacker +2000." (While attacking, a creature that has "power attacker +2000" gets +2000 power.)
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)

name: Volcanic Arrows
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Destroy a creature that has power 6000 or less.
Choose one of your shields and put it into your graveyard.

name: Aurora of Reversal
rulesText: Choose any number of your shields and put them into your mana zone.
flavorText: The forest hasn't grown this fast since the ancient invasion of the fertilizer fiends.

name: Dawn Giant
rulesText:
This creature can't attack creatures.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: That's not the sound of an earthquake. That's just the Dawn Giants snoring.

name: Gigamantis
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Giant Insects.
Whenever another of your nature creatures would be put into your graveyard from the battle zone, put it into your mana zone instead.
flavorText: "But I don't wanna be a tree!" —Fear Fang

name: Mana Nexus
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Add a card from your mana zone to your shields face down.

rulesText:

name: Pouch Shell

Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Return a creature that costs 6 or more from your mana zone to your hand.

name: Sniper Mosquito
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, return a card from your mana zone to your hand.

name: Miar, Comet Elemental
rulesText: Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)

name: Chaos Fish
rulesText:
This creature gets +1000 power for each other water creature you have in the battle zone.

Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)

rulesText:
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
Whenever this creature attacks, return all creatures from your mana zone to your hand.
